candidates.title: The booking site keeps the guest's email
candidates.pinned_comment:
[EPISODE_URL]

Booking.com's own partner help says it does not share private guest email addresses: both sides see an alias ending @guest.booking.com, and partners are asked to keep the conversation on the platform. The full episode covers what an outside operator can and cannot legally do with a guest list under those terms.
